# restate_cloud_region_grant (Resource)

A Managed BYOC region grant: access to one AWS account, GCP project or Azure subscription that builds any number of BYOC regions there.

A grant has two halves. This resource is Restate's half. It answers the values the cloud half is built from (`restate_issuer`, `grant_subject`, `token_audience` and `resource_prefix`), which go to the grant module in [modules/byoc](https://github.com/restatedev/terraform-provider-restate/tree/main/modules/byoc), which can also create this resource and its confirmation itself. `restate_cloud_region_grant_confirmation` then hands the module's output to Restate, which signs in through it and marks the grant `READY`. Only then can `restate_cloud_byoc_region` build regions with it.

A grant that is not confirmed within seven days expires. A refresh that finds the grant expired or deleted removes it from the state, so the next apply creates a new one.

The API has no update operation, so changing any argument replaces the grant, and a grant that regions still use cannot be deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Restate's half of a Managed BYOC grant for one AWS account. Its outputs are the inputs of the grant
# module in modules/byoc of this repository, which creates the cloud half: an IAM role that trusts
# Restate's issuer for this grant's subject, and only reaches names that start with resource_prefix.
resource "restate_cloud_region_grant" "aws" {
  cloud            = "aws"
  cloud_account_id = "123456789012"

  # ORGANIZATION lets every account of the organization build regions with the grant. It needs the
  # organization's administrator, or an organization API key with role
  # rst:role::OrganizationRegionGrantAccess, as the provider's credential.
  owner = "ACCOUNT"
}

output "grant_module_inputs" {
  value = {
    restate_issuer  = restate_cloud_region_grant.aws.restate_issuer
    grant_subject   = restate_cloud_region_grant.aws.grant_subject
    token_audience  = restate_cloud_region_grant.aws.token_audience
    resource_prefix = restate_cloud_region_grant.aws.resource_prefix
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud` (String) Cloud the grant is in: `aws`, `gcp` or `azure`.
- `cloud_account_id` (String) The AWS account ID, GCP project ID or Azure subscription ID the grant is in. Every region built with the grant runs there. Restate confirms only one grant for each cloud account.

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Name shown for the grant. Restate chooses one when it is omitted. A live grant for the same cloud account keeps its name, so asking for another one is refused.
- `owner` (String) Who owns the grant. `ACCOUNT` (the default): the provider's account, whose administrators and management keys manage it and build regions with it. `ORGANIZATION`: the account's organization, whose administrators and organization API keys with role `rst:role::OrganizationRegionGrantAccess` manage it and build regions with it in any of its accounts. An account's management key cannot manage an organization's grant.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account the grant was created through. For an `ORGANIZATION` grant this is any account of the organization, and the grant's owner is `owner_id`.
- `created_at` (String) When the grant was created.
- `expires_at` (String) While the grant is `PENDING`: when it expires unless it is confirmed. Empty once it is confirmed.
- `grant_subject` (String) Subject of the grant's token, `grant:<grant ID>`. The grant module's `grant_subject`.
- `id` (String) Grant ID assigned by Restate Cloud, for example `rgr_x5z2y4qjmt`.
- `owner_id` (String) ID of the account or organization that owns the grant.
- `region_ids` (List of String) Regions built with the grant that are not deleted yet.
- `resource_prefix` (String) Prefix of every resource name a region of the grant has in the cloud account. The grant module's `resource_prefix`.
- `restate_issuer` (String) Restate's OIDC issuer, which signs the grant's token. The grant module's `restate_issuer`.
- `status` (String) `PENDING` until the grant is confirmed, then `READY`. A grant that expired or was deleted is removed from the state on refresh.
- `status_reason` (String) While the grant is `PENDING`: `AWAITING_CONFIRMATION`, `CONFIRMING` while Restate signs in through the cloud grant, or `CONFIRMATION_FAILED` when the cloud kept refusing. Empty once the grant is `READY`.
- `token_audience` (String) Audience of the grant's token. The grant module's `token_audience`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Region grants are imported by account ID and grant ID together. For an organization's grant, the
# account is the one the provider is configured for.
terraform import restate_cloud_region_grant.aws acc_1a2b3c/rgr_x5z2y4qjmt
```
